findings.title: A non-JSON Content-Type gets an undeclared 415 instead of the contract's 400 (or 413 when oversized)
findings.reason: The 415 is raised at handler mapping (generated consumes=application/json), before any profile code runs; it is still RFC 7807 problem+json from the shared advice, never a 500, and echoes nothing. Declaring 415 (or mapping it to 400) is a contract decision for the docs store (api/openapi.yaml), which this backend change may not edit; noted for the next contract bump.

findings.title: The display name is read through Environment, which resolves `${...}` placeholders in the value
The display name is read through Spring's placeholder-resolving Environment, so a value containing '${' can be echoed in the startup error or silently replaced
Task 5.4 (compose smoke) is ticked but was skipped and has no artifact
The unknown answer-mode message tells the child to use GUIDED, which is always refused
A configured task locale longer than 16 characters passes validation, then fails on the DB write as a raw 500
Coverage summary: 11 change-spec scenarios: 10 implemented, 1 partial, 0 missing, 0 contradicted. The in-scope store-spec scenarios add 2 more partials (UTF-8 bytes, container restart).
findings.reason: Informational coverage summary, no defect.
